documentedMechanicPrior.interpretation: The securing side has an approximately 80 ms confirmation advantage. This script does not assume whether that is implemented as an exclusive deny lockout or server-side race adjudication.

interpretation.behavioralImplication: Secure and deny opportunity timing must remain role-specific. Stimulus existence and player survival are insufficient to establish an actionable opportunity.
interpretation.weaponSpecificImplication: Two players in equivalent geometry may have different opportunity strength because firing state, projectile velocity, projectile travel time, reload state, rate-of-fire lockout, spread, and other hero/weapon characteristics affect earliest achievable orb impact.

futureMetrics.earliestEffectiveHitTime: Earliest mechanically possible projectile/orb impact for a particular player given state and weapon.
futureMetrics.securePriorityMargin: Secure-priority deadline minus earliest mechanically possible secure impact.
futureMetrics.contestMargin: Relative weapon-adjusted effective-impact timing for securing and denying sides.
futureMetrics.avoidableDeny: A later deny following a sufficiently strong prior secure opportunity. Not yet classified in this script.
